examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The band as the Functions page places it: the overline, headline and lead centered over two calls to action, then three illustrated cells in a three-column bento grid — a copy button that puts a prompt on the clipboard for the agent path, and outlined link buttons for the Console and terminal paths. Edit the props in the Controls panel — a band with no items renders nothing at all.

site.name: Default
site.summary: The Functions Get started band: three cells, each a path from a prompt to a deployed function, one ending in a copy button and two in a docs link.
